name: Javelin of Lightning
description: A javelin with a head of blue-white metal that smells of storms.
body:
## What it does

Once a day, hurl it and speak its word and it becomes a bolt of lightning, a line 5 feet wide that runs from you to a target within 120 feet. Everyone else in the line makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 lightning damage on a failure and half on a success. Then make a ranged attack against the target: a hit deals the javelin's damage and the lightning's besides. It turns back into a javelin when it arrives.

damage.note: when thrown as the bolt of lightning

features.name: Bolt
features.text: Every other creature in the 5-foot line to the target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4d6 lightning damage on a failure and half on a success.
